report_summary: This followup substantially strengthens the XSS account by tracing same-prefix request/save alignments and separating payload, execution, causal linkage and downstream impact. It explicitly limits benchmark and identity conclusions, but incorrectly treats deleted bodies and summaries as unavailable and begins the complete deletion span onJune18 rather thanJune4.
